findings: The all-branch response is complete according to its total_count: 74 unique runs, covering four distinct head SHAs. The earlier head-only limitation is removed for this visible branch result set.

The original 19 current-head runs are still the complete set created today. All 74 runs report run_attempt=1. There is no visible later run or new attempt in this branch result set to explain the target cancellation window.

Exactly four blocking-ci runs are visible, one at each head. The three prior heads completed with failure on November 4; the current original run is still reported queued despite actual individual-job activity. This status is preserved without treating it as no execution.

limits: This excludes a competing later run or new attempt only within the exact branch records visible to this connection at the observation time. It does not prove that no record was deleted or inaccessible.
